_about: What a public dataset exposes. check-dataset.mjs runs `probes` anonymously; src/app/dataset-exposure.test.ts makes every document type in the Studio schema appear under `types`, so a new type or sensitive field cannot be added without deciding how it is handled. A passing probe is a tripwire for the sensitive things the template knows about. It does not prove a public dataset is safe.

enquiry.why: A visitor's name and email address.

place.why: Shown on the website, including a branch's address, phone and opening hours.

teamMember.why: Shown on the website, including the public email and phone.

businessInfo.why: Shown on the website: trading details, public email, phone and address.

redirect.why: Every redirect is visible to anyone who follows it.

stripePrice.why: Prices are shown on the website.

experiment.why: Test configuration; no personal data. Visible if the dataset is public.

assist.instruction.context.why: Studio AI instructions. Visible if the dataset is public; keep secrets out of them.

sanity.fileAsset.why: Uploaded files and their original filenames. File URLs are public on Sanity's CDN whatever the dataset's setting.

sanity.imageAsset.why: Uploaded images and their original filenames. Image URLs are public on Sanity's CDN whatever the dataset's setting.

publicFields._about: Fields on non-probed types whose names suggest personal or secret data, and why each is fine to publish. A new field matching the pattern fails the test until it is listed here or its type is probed.

fields.teamMember.publicEmail: A public contact address, shown on the website.
fields.teamMember.phone: A public contact number, shown on the website.
fields.place.publicEmail: A branch's public contact address, shown on its page.
fields.place.phone: A branch's public contact number, shown on its page.
fields.place.address: A branch's address, shown on its page.
fields.businessInfo.publicEmail: A public contact address, shown on the website.
fields.businessInfo.phone: A public contact number, shown on the website.
fields.businessInfo.address: The business address, shown on the website.
